device.description: 12-bit serial-control ADC with 11 analog inputs, programmable output length/order, unipolar or bipolar output and EOC
device.note: tlc2543-ep.pdf (SGLS125A) p.1 pinout, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 operating characteristics, p.12-17 principles of operation (Table 2 input register p.14, data length p.15, LSBF/BIP/EOC p.16, power down p.17); same content in tlc2543.pdf (SLAS079F) and tlc2543-q1.pdf

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the 8-bit input data register (Table 2, p.14); set to all zeroes at power up (p.13)

commands.name: Software power down (address 1110), 8-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: p.17: address 1110 selects power down; no conversion is performed, the I/O cycle must still be completed

commands.name: Select channel / test voltage, 8-bit I/O cycle
commands.note: Table 2 (p.14): D7-D4 address, D3-D2 L1 L0 (01 = 8, x0 = 12, 11 = 16 clocks), D1 LSBF, D0 BIP; the conversion starts after the last (8th/12th/16th) I/O CLOCK falling edge (p.15)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (t(conv) 10 us, td(I/O-DATA) 150 ns, tPZH 1.3 us, tPHZ 150 ns, td(I/O-EOC) 2.2 us), p.12-13 (I/O cycle, power up, Table 1), p.14 (Table 2), p.15-17 (data length, LSBF, BIP, EOC, pad bits, CS, power down), p.17-18 (Tables 3-5)
notModeled: analog inputs, references and multiplexer: every conversion returns the 0 V code (unipolar 000h; bipolar (BIP=1) 800h, the code of Vref- = 0 V, which the datasheet calls signed binary relative to (Vref+ + Vref-)/2: modeled as codeFormat offset)
self-test addresses 1011/1100/1101 output 800h/000h/FFFh (Table 3); modeled as conversions returning the 0 V code; address 1111 (undocumented) is treated as a conversion
software power down (address 1110) and the power-down state after power on: modeled as an I/O cycle that starts no conversion (current draw not modeled)

data length: the datasheet applies D3-D2 to the current I/O cycle; MSB-first output is the same for every length (12 result bits then zeros), LSB-first ordering uses the length and LSBF of the previous cycle (a length change in LSB-first mode corrupts one result per p.15)
result pipelining (output is the previous conversion, first result after power up random): the result is constant
CS held low continuously (the next I/O cycle begins at EOC rising): only CS-framed transfers are modeled
conversion start: the datasheet starts it after the last I/O CLOCK falling edge with EOC falling td(I/O-EOC) 2.2 us later; modeled at the last rising edge (command completion)
CS debounce / setup time (tsu(CS) 1.425 us), CS abort of a conversion
tValid = tPZH 1.3 us; tOut = td(I/O-DATA) 150 ns; tFloat = tPHZ 150 ns
variants: tlc2543.pdf (TLC2543C/I/M), tlc2543-ep.pdf (TLC2543-EP: MDBREP, QDWREP) and tlc2543-q1.pdf (TLC2543-Q1: IDBRQ1) describe the same chip with the same 20-pin numbering for DB, DW and J.
